responsibility: This file provides the low-level RTL construction and instruction-chain machinery used by the expander. It owns global and per-function RTL state such as canonical constant RTX objects, pseudo-register tables, insn UID/label numbering, cached hash-consed RTL constants and register attributes, instruction duplication and note copying, source-location attachment for insns, and basic helpers for creating and linking RTL objects, serving as the foundational layer on which expr/calls/stmt/optabs expansion builds function RTL.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file in the `emit-rtl` group: it owns the backing RTL state, canonical RTX objects, hash-consed constants, insn copying/linking, UID/label allocation, and source-location machinery, whereas `gcc/emit-rtl.h` publishes the data structures, inline accessors, and constructor/manipulation APIs.
